entries.toelichting: Ahilud-father-of-Jehoshaphat-king's-recorder (2Sam 8:16; 20:24; 1Kgs 4:3,12; 1Chr 18:15). English convention: Ahilud. 'Brother-of-the-born' or 'my-brother-is-a-child'.
Proper noun, Levi-Kohath-branch descendant; 1Chr 6:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahimoth.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-king'); priest at Nob killed by Saul; concordantly transliterated.
Anakite-giant in Hebron and Levitical gate-keeper (Num 13:22; Josh 15:14; Judg 1:10; 1Chr 9:17). English convention: Ahiman. 'Brother-of-the-gift'.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-vexation'?); son of Zadok, swift runner with the news of Absalom's death; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Manasseh tribe-head son of Shemida; 1Chr 7:19; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahian.
Proper noun, Solomon's-district-officer Mahanaim; 1Kgs 4:14; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahinadab.
Gentilic of Ahoah, Benjamite family of David's mighty men (2Sam 23:9,28; 1Chr 8:4; 11:12,29; 27:4). English convention: Ahohite.
Ahisamach-father-of-Oholiab-the-tabernacle-builder (Ex 31:6; 35:34; 38:23). English convention: Ahisamach. 'Brother-supports' or 'my-brother-has-supported'.
Dan tribe-head and David's mighty man (Num 1:12; 2:25; 7:66,71; 10:25; 1Chr 12:3). 'My-brother-is-help'. English convention: Ahiezer.
Proper noun ('my-brother-has-arisen'); son of Shaphan, protector of Jeremiah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Benjamin; Num 26:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahiram.
Patronym-clan Ahiram; Num 26:38; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahiramite.
Naphtalite tribe-head at Sinai-numbering (Num 1:15; 2:29; 7:78,83; 10:27). English convention: Ahira. 'My-brother-is-evil'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Jediael; 1Chr 7:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahishahar.
Proper noun, Solomon's-palace-administrator; 1Kgs 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahishar.
Proper noun ('my-brother-is-folly'); David's counsellor, traitor in Absalom's revolt; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Asher-city-not-driven-out; Judg 1:31; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahlab.

1Chr-and-Sheshan-had-a-daughter-her-name-was-Ahlai and 1Chr-Zabad-the-son-of-Ahlai (1Chr 2:31; 11:41). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ahlai-daughter-Sheshan-Jarha-married-father-Attai-Zabad-aspect from other Ach-names; female-proper-noun-heritance.
Wish-exclamation; oh that-my-ways were-fixed; Ps 119:5.
Gemstone row 3 breastplate; identity-uncertain; Ex 28:19; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic-proper-noun Persian summer-residence Ecbatana; Ezra 6:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Achmetha.
David's-warrior-father 2Sam 23:34; father of Eliphelet-Maakathite.
Qal/Piel: linger, delay, come later; the hyphenated English marks position (distinguished from achar prep 'after').
Root 'hr (to remain behind, to come). Temporal and spatial 'after/behind'. 'After' covers temporal; spatial 'behind' shares the same kernel.
Second-sense acharai; rebuker-finds-more-favour-afterward; Prov 28:23.
Aramaic parallel to achar; another-king after them; Dan 7:24.
Root 'hr. 'Other' as following/succeeding; related to achar (preposition, H310a).
Proper noun, Benjamin-father of Hushim; 1Chr 7:12; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aher.
Adjective from √achar; what comes at the back in time or space; concordantly 'last'.
Proper noun, Benjamin tribe-head son of Bela; 1Chr 8:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aharah.
Proper noun, son of Harum-Coz-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aharhel.

Aramaic-designation for following-kingdom (Dan 2:39; 7:6,8,20,24). Hyphenated to distinguish the other-following-succeeding-aramaic-aspect from H312 acher 'other-following-Hebrew' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
Aramaic for last-came-in Daniel; Dan 4:8.
From √achar (behind); what comes last in time/space; the hyphenated English covers 'end' (time) and 'latter-part' (place).
Aramaic end-latter-days (Dan 2:28); cognate Hebrew H319 acharit.

Dan-aramaic-other-kingdom and Dan-aramaic-other-dream and Dan-aramaic-other-ten-horns (Dan 2:11,39,44; 3:29; 7:5,6,8,20,24). Hyphenated to distinguish the other-remaining-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew acher-other (already assigned); Aramaic-cognate-demonstrative.

Behind-the-back-turned-going-back; Noah's sons, Elijah's shadow, Hezekiah's sign (Gen 9:23; 1Sam 4:18; 2Sam 1:22; 2Kgs 20:10,11; Isa 38:8). Direction-adverb, distinguished from H268 achor 'behind-part'.

Persian-province-administrator at Esther and Darius (Esth 3:12; 8:9; 9:3; Ezra 8:36). Hyphenated to distinguish the satrap-governor-aspect from H324 achashdarpan-aramaic 'satrap-aramaic' (already assigned) and H6346 pechah 'governor' (already assigned); Persian loanword 'protector-of-the-realm'.
Old-Persian loanword 'protector-of-the-realm'. Persian provincial administrator (Dan 3:2,3,27; 6:2,3,4,6,7). Aramaic parallel of H323 Hebrew attestation.
Proper noun; Persian king (Xerxes); concordantly transliterated.
Patronym-clan of Ashur-Tekoa-Judah-branch; 1Chr 4:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ahashtarite.
The fast royal courier-horses of the Persian post-service - Esther 8:10 (the messengers rode on the swift courier-horses from the royal stud) and 8:14; Persian loanword for racing-horse.
First-sense at; Egyptians consult spirit-mediums; Isa 19:3.
Calmly-without-haste happening of steps or movement (Gen 33:14; 2Sam 18:5; Isa 8:6; Job 15:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the calm-softness-aspect from homonym H328a at-I 'magic-whisper'.
Thorny hedge-plant or buckthorn (Gen 50:10,11; Judg 9:14,15; Ps 58:10). Hyphenated to preserve the dense-spiny-hedge-plant.
Fine-Egyptian-linen on woman-bed; Prov 7:16.
Stop ears or lips (1Kgs 6:4; Ps 58:5; Prov 17:28; 21:13; Isa 33:15; Lam 3:8). Hyphenated to preserve the closing-shutting-action.
Qal; pit-would-not-shut-its-mouth-over-me; Ps 69:15.
Judah-ancestor whose clan returned (Ezra 2:16,42; Neh 7:21,45; 10:18). English convention: Ater. 'Left-handed-shut'.

Judg-and-the-children-of-Israel-cried-to-the-LORD-and-the-LORD-raised-up-them-a-deliverer-Ehud-the-son-of-Gera-a-Benjamite-a-man-impeded-of-his-right-hand and Judg-among-all-this-people-were-seven-hundred-chosen-men-impeded-of-their-right-hand (Judg 3:15; 20:16). Hyphenated to preserve the impeded-right-hand-left-handed-aspect; Benjamite-warrior-trait.
Interrogative adverb of place, weak form alongside ayyeh; concordantly 'where-II' (distinguished from ayyeh).
Hapax-form 'not-innocent'; through-purity-of-hands-delivered; Job 22:30.
Lament-cry woe-to; idiomatic Ecclesiastes-blessing-curse.

Isa-jackals-shall-cry-in-their-palaces and Isa-desert-howl-wild-dogs and Jer-wild-dogs-in-desolate-places (Isa 13:22; 34:14; Jer 50:39). Hyphenated to distinguish the jackal-desert-wild-dog-howling-creature-aspect from H8577 tannin 'serpent-dragon' and H8568 tannah 'jackal'.
Piece of land surrounded by water, also remote coastal-region; concordantly 'island'.
Qal; I-will-be-hostile-against-your-enemies; Ex 23:22.
Unique lexeme. Participle of root 'yb (to be hostile). 'Enemy' standard.

Deep-rooted enmity between parties (Gen 3:15; Num 35:21,22; Eze 25:15; 35:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the structural-enmity-aspect from H8135 sinah 'hatred' (feeling); family with H340 ayav 'be-hostile'.
Disastrous adversity, day of doom; concordantly 'calamity'.

Unclean-birds-of-prey list and Job-eye-sharp (Lev 11:14; Deut 14:13; Job 28:7). Hyphenated to distinguish the kite-falcon-bird-of-prey-aspect from H5404 nesher 'eagle' (already assigned) and H1772 dayyah 'vulture-kite' and H7201a ra'ah 'bird-of-prey'.
Horite tribe-head and father of Rizpah (Gen 36:24; 2Sam 3:7; 21:8,10,11; 1Chr 1:40). English convention: Aiah.
Interrogative adverb of place; distinguished from efo; concordantly 'where'.
Proper noun; protagonist of Book of Job; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun; Phoenician wife of Ahab; concordantly transliterated.
Question-word/exclamation-word; concordantly 'how' (distinguished from echah = lament-how).
Lament-cry adverb: 'ah, how!' (opening-word of Lamentations); the hyphenated English marks emotion (distinguished from ech 'how-question').

Intensive-how-question in Esther and Song-of-Songs (Esth 8:6 twice; Song 5:3 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish the how-what-way-aspect from homonyms H349a ech 'how' and H349b echah 'how-lament' (both already assigned).

1S-she-named-the-child-Ichabod-saying-the-glory-is-departed-from-Israel and 1S-Ichabod-the-brother-of-Ahitub-the-son-of-Phinehas (1S 4:21; 14:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the Ichabod-glory-departed-birth-aspect from other names; family with H3519 kavod 'glory'.
Aram-king asks where Elisha is; 2Kgs 6:13.
Unique lexeme. Male sheep. 'Ram' covers the anatomical and metaphorical (leader). Note: architectural 'pillar' may be context-derived.

Architectural pillar in temple-gate (1Kgs 6:31; Eze 40:9,10,14,16,21,24,26,29,31,33,34,36,37,38,48; 41:1,3). Hyphenated to distinguish the post-pillar-aspect from H5982 ammud 'pillar' and homonym H352a ayil-I 'ram-sheep'.

Leading-ruler or mighty-one in popular-relation (Ex 15:15; 2Kgs 24:15; Eze 17:13; 31:11). Hyphenated to distinguish the leader-noble-aspect from homonyms H352a ayil-I 'ram' and H352b ayil-II 'doorpost-pillar' (already assigned); family with H193 ul.

Isa-you-shall-be-ashamed-of-the-oaks-you-have-desired and Eze-the-rulers-of-the-trees-by-all-waters-which-were-well-watered (Isa 1:29; Eze 31:14 cf). Hyphenated to distinguish the oaks-terebinths-mighty-trees-aspect from H362 Elim 'place-name'.
David's-strength-spent in death-comparison; Ps 88:4.
Male-deer-like-ruminant in-Levitical-food-list distinguished from tsevi (gazelle, H6643) by horn-bearing-aspect (Deut 12:15,22, 14:5, 15:22 food-prescriptions); concordantly 'stag'.
Female deer; Naphtali as released hind, Habakkuk's foot-sure (Gen 49:21; 2Sam 22:34; Job 39:1; Ps 18:34; 22:1; 29:9; Prov 5:19; Jer 14:5; Hab 3:19). Female counterpart of H354 ayyal 'stag'.
Hittite-father-in-law of Esau, Zebulun-descendant and a judge (Gen 26:34; 36:2; 46:14; Num 26:26; Josh 19:43; Judg 12:11,12). English convention: Elon.

Place/valley in Danite inheritance (Josh 10:12 'Sun, stand still over Gibeon; and moon, in valley of Aijalon' Joshua's-miracle during-Amorite-battle, 19:42, 21:24 = 1Chr 6:69 Levitical-city, Judg 1:35 'Amorites-persisted in Aijalon', 12:12 Elon-judicial-burial); concordantly transliterated. English convention: Aijalon.
Solomon-district 1Kgs 4:9 place-name Elon-with-house-Hanan; compound. English convention: Elon-beth-hanan.

Elath-port-city-Red-Sea-recovered-by-Uzziah and Rezin-of-Aram-took-Elath-back (Deut 2:8; 2Kgs 14:22; 16:6). English convention: Elath. Distinguished from possible homonym-related H358 Elot 'tree-place' (if already assigned); family with H352 ayil.

Red-Sea-port-city in Edom-territory (Deut 2:8; 1Kgs 9:26; 2Kgs 14:22; 16:6; 2Chr 26:2). English convention: Eloth. 'Oak-grove'. Distinguished from homonym H359a ayil-oak and from H352 ayil 'ram-oak' (already assigned).
My-help-strength haste-You to-help-me; Ps 22:19.
Temple-architecture Eze 40-41 vestibule-portico before sanctuary-door; root uncertain.
Oasis with twelve springs in the wilderness (Ex 15:27; 16:1; Num 33:9,10). English convention: Elim.
Aramaic-equivalent for tree in Nebuchadnezzar's dream (Dan 4:7,8,11,14,17,20,23,26). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; distinguished from Hebrew H352b ayil-II 'doorpost-pillar'.
Proper noun, place at the edge of the wilderness; Gen 14:6; concordantly transliterated. English convention: El-paran.
Wife-as-graceful-hind; Prov 5:19.

Hab-fearful-dreadful-is-his-judgment and Song-terrible-as-bannered-armies and Song-awesome-as-armies (Hab 1:7; Song 6:4,10). Hyphenated to distinguish the awesome-fearful-dread-aspect from H3372 yare 'fear' (already assigned); concordantly 'awesome-fearful-dread'.
Paralysing fear, threatening spectre; concordantly 'terror'.
Emim-giant-people and pre-inhabitants-of-Moab (Gen 14:5; Deut 2:10,11). English convention: Emites. 'Terrifying-ones'; family-type with Rephaim and Anakites.
Negative existence-particle. English has no single-word equivalent; 'there-is-no' preserves the existential negation that 'not' (H3808, H408) does not cover.
Interrogative adverb: 'whence?'; the hyphenated English distinguishes from ayin noun 'nothing'.
Hapax variant of ayin; 1Sam 21:8.
Proper noun, son of Gilead; Num 26:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Iezer.
Patronym-clan Iezer; Num 26:30; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Iezerite.
Dry capacity-measure for grain (about 22 litres); concordantly transliterated.

Interrogative 'where?' - Joseph seeks brothers (Gen 37:16 'where do they pasture?'), Gideon's-brothers (Judg 8:18 'where-are-the-men?'), Saul seeks David-Samuel (1Sam 19:22), David's question about-Mephibosheth (2Sam 9:4), Jeroboam-wife-with-Ahijah (1Kgs 14:2 asked), Aramaeans-Elisha (2Kgs 6:13).
Root 'ysh or 'nsh. Semantically 'individual male being'; female parallel ishshah (H802). Also idiomatically 'each one', 'every'. Distinguished from H120 adam (human, gender-neutral species).
Hithpolel; be-manly and consider-this; Isa 46:8.

Fourth son Saul who after Saul's-death reigned over eleven tribes in Mahanaim under Abner against David (2Sam 2:8,10,12,15, 3:7-8,14-15, 4:5-12 murdered-in-bed); 'man-of-shame' (originally Ish-Baal in 1Chr 8:33, 9:39, masoretically adjusted); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, son of Hammoleketh Manasseh-branch; 1Chr 7:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ishhod.
Little-man-in-the-eye, deepest-night (Deut 32:10; Ps 17:8; Prov 7:2,9; 20:20; Lam 2:18). Hyphenated to preserve the pupil-apple-of-eye-aspect; diminutive-family with H376 ish 'man'.
Aramaic-cognate of-Hebrew-H3426 yesh (there-is/existence-particle) distinguished by Aramaic-language-form in-Daniel-and-Ezra (Ezra 4:16, 5:17, 6:9 Persian-administrative; Dan 2:10-11, 3:12,17,29).

Ithiel-Benjamite-tribe-head-post-exile-Nehemiah and Ithiel-Agur-proverb-addressee (Neh 11:7; Prov 30:1 twice). English convention: Ithiel. 'God-is-with-me' or 'God-with-me' (et-with + El-God already assigned).
Proper noun; fourth son of Aaron; concordantly transliterated.
Durable, uninterrupted (always-flowing brook, mighty peoples); the hyphenated English marks the unchanging strength.
Ezrahite wise-man and Levitical singer (1Kgs 5:11; 1Chr 2:6,8; 6:27,32; 15:17,19; Ps 89:1). English convention: Ethan. 'Steadfast'; family with H386 ethan 'enduring-firm'.
Proper noun seventh month (September/October) temple-dedication; 1Kgs 8:2; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ethanim.
Restrictive/asseverative particle. 'Only' covers the limitation; also asseverative ('verily').
Proper noun, city in Shinar; Gen 10:10; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Accad.

Deceitful brook or lying-water that dries up in dry seasons - in Jeremiah 15:18 (will You be to me as a deceitful brook, as waters that fail?) and Micah 1:14 (the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel).
Two Judah- and Asher-cities by the Mediterranean (Josh 15:44; 19:29; Judg 1:31; Mic 1:14). English convention: Achzib. 'Deceit-lying'; family with H391 akhzav 'deceitful'.

Merciless enemy or soul-hardness (Deut 32:33; Jer 30:14; 50:42; Prov 5:9). Hyphenated to distinguish the cruel-merciless-aspect from H2555 chamas 'violence' and H394 akhzari 'cruel-merciless' (gentilic-variant).

Cruel-feelingless in action (Job 30:21; Prov 5:9; 11:17; 12:10; 17:11; Jer 6:23; 30:14; 50:42; Lam 4:3). Hyphenated to mark the compassion-less-aspect; family with H393 akzar 'cruel' (nominal-synonym).
Cruelty-and-overflowing-anger hard-to-bear; Prov 27:4.
Food-strength for 40 days Elijah to Horeb; 1Kgs 19:8.
Proper noun; Philistine king of Gath; concordantly transliterated.
Root 'kl. Derived okel (food, H400), oklah (food, H402). 'Eat' is kernel.
Aramaic 'eat/devour' (Dan 3:8; 4:30; 6:25; 7:5,7,19,23). Concordant via '-aramaic' suffix; family with Hebrew H398 akal.
From √achal (eat); food-object; distinguished from lechem (bread); concordantly 'food'.
Proper noun, presumably disciple of Agur; Prov 30:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ucal.
From √achal (eat); that which is eaten, fodder; concordantly 'fodder' (distinguished from maachal).
Affirmative-contrastive adverb: truly, indeed; concordantly 'verily'.
Qal; hunger-presses-worker-to-work; Prov 16:26.
Elihu's-urging not heavy on Job; Job 33:7.
Land-cultivator or farmer of fields (Isa 61:5; Jer 14:4; 31:24; 51:23; Joel 1:11; Amos 5:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the farmer-husbandman-aspect from H3009 yagav 'till-land'.
Achshaph-city-king-Jabin-coalition and Asher-border-place (Josh 11:1; 12:20; 19:25). English convention: Achshaph. 'I-am-bewitched' or 'enchantment-place' (family with kashaph-bewitch).
Prohibitive negation (negative imperative). To be distinguished from lo (H3808, absolute negation). 'Not!' with exclamation marks the prohibitive character.

Ezra-aramaic-not-suspend-the-work and Dan-aramaic-not-be-troubled and Dan-aramaic-not-let-countenance-be-changed (Ezra 4:22; 6:8; Dan 2:24). Hyphenated to distinguish the not-aramaic-negation-aspect from H408 al-Hebrew 'not-cohortative' (already assigned).

Root 'wl. Shortened form of eloah/elohim (H433/H430). Concordantly identical: 'Mighty-One' (singular). Preserves concordance via the same English root-form. 'God' is a cultural choice that does not preserve the root-meaning of the Hebrew (strong/mighty).

Demonstrative 'these' (plural); variant alongside H428 elleh in Hebrew. Gen 19:8,25; 26:3,4; Lev 18:27; Deut 4:42; 7:22; 1Chr 20:8. Homonym of H410 El 'Mighty-One' and H413 el 'to'; numbering '-III' per homonym-protocol.

Aramaic demonstrative 'these' plural - Ezra 5:15 (these vessels bring and place them in the temple) and Daniel Aramaic context; distinguished from H1791 dek-aramaic (already assigned) as singular-pointer.
Direction-marking preposition. 'To' preserves the kernel of directed movement; to be distinguished from 'al (H5921a, position-on).
Proper noun, father of Solomon's-district-officer Shimei-Benjamin; 1Kgs 4:18; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ela.

Eze-I-will-rain-hailstones-fire-sulphur and Eze-hailstones-from-God and Eze-great-hailstones-falling (Eze 13:11,13; 38:22). Hyphenated to distinguish the hailstone-ice-block-large-aspect from H1259 barad 'hail' (already assigned); Ezekiel-exclusive.

Algum-wood-Ophir-temple-construction-Solomon and algum-beams-temple-musicians-instruments and algum-Lebanon-wood-David-stockpile (1Chr 2:8; 9:10,11; 2Chr 9:10,11). Hyphenated to distinguish the algum-precious-wood-sandalwood-Lebanon-wood-aspect from H484 almuggim variant.

Num-and-the-Spirit-rested-on-them-and-they-prophesied-and-Eldad-and-Medad and Num-a-young-man-ran-and-told-Moses-and-said-Eldad-and-Medad-prophesy-in-the-camp (Num 11:26,27). Hyphenated to distinguish the Eldad-seventy-elders-aspect from other names.

Gen-sons-Midian-Abida-Eldaah and 1Chr-sons-Midian-Eldaah (Gen 25:4; 1Chr 1:33). Hyphenated to distinguish the Eldaah-son-Midian-Abraham-grandson-aspect from others; 'God-knows'-theophoric-name-Midian-line.
Hapax-exclamation lament-young-bride; Joel 1:8.

Place-under-oath with imprecation in covenant or testimony (Judg 17:2; 1Sam 14:24; 1Kgs 8:31; 2Chr 6:22; Hos 4:2; 10:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the imprecating-oath-action from H779 arar 'curse' and H7043 qalal 'curse'; family with H423 alah noun.
Solemnly pronounced oath with self-curse as sanction; concordantly 'imprecation'.
Large deciduous broadleaf tree (Abraham under terebinth, Absalom's hair); the hyphenated English distinguishes from Elah pn.
Proper noun ('terebinth'); king of Israel, father of Hoshea, valley near Socoh; concordantly transliterated.
Aramaic form, equivalent of eloah/elohim. Concordantly identical: 'Mighty-One'.
Great-oak by sanctuary Shechem; Josh 24:26.
Demonstrative plural. 'These' is unambiguously plural.
Aramaic parallel to elleh; idols like-these will-perish; Jer 10:11.

Root 'wl/'lh (to be strong, mighty). Plural form of eloah (H433); shortened el (H410). 'Mighty-One' departs from the root; 'God' is a cultural choice that does not preserve the root. The plural form is held semantically singular when referring to the Ene (pluralis-majestatis); plural-of-actual-gods or plural-of-judges surfaces in render.

Aramaic-deictic 'behold' at dream-visions (Dan 2:31; 4:7,10; 7:8). Hyphenated to distinguish the behold-look-aramaic-aspect from H2005 hen 'behold' (already assigned) and H7200 ra'ah 'see' (already assigned) and H718 aru-aramaic 'see-aramaic'; Aramaic deictic.
Esther: 'if-only-sold-as-slaves'; Esth 7:4.
Singular of elohim; poetic form (especially Job, Psalms); concordantly 'Mighty-One' (same lexeme as H430/H410).
Jer 14:14 false-prophets-divination-nothing; nothingness-idol cognate with H410 El (negation).
Proper noun, sixth month (Aug/Sept); wall-completion Nehemiah; Neh 6:15; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elul.

Large tree (probably terebinth-pistachio); marker-places for meeting/revelation (Gen 12:6; 13:18; 14:13; 18:1; Deut 11:30; Josh 19:33; Judg 4:11; 9:6,37; 1Sam 10:3). Hyphenated; alongside H437 allon oak.

Sturdy-broadleaf oak, sacred-place-tree (Gen 35:8; Josh 19:33; Isa 2:13; 6:13; 44:14; Eze 27:6; Hos 4:13; Amos 2:9; Zech 11:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the species-specific from H436 elon 'terebinth-tree'.

Josh-border-Naphtali-turned-from-Heleph-from-Oak-in-Zaanannim-and-Adami-Hannekeb-and-Jabneel-to-Lakkum-going-out-at-the-Jordan and Judg-Heber-the-Kenite-separated-from-Cain-pitched-his-tent-as-far-as-the-Oak-of-Zaanannim-which-is-by-Kedesh (Josh 19:33; Judg 4:11 cf). Hyphenated.
Proper noun ('oak-of-weeping') burial-place of Deborah; Gen 35:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Allon-bacuth.
Patronym-clan son of Zebulun; Num 26:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elonite.

Intimate friend; also metaphorically of YHWH as youth-friend (Ps 55:14; Prov 2:17; 16:28; 17:9; Jer 3:4; 11:19; 13:21; Mic 7:5). Hyphenated to distinguish the intimate-closeness-aspect from H7453 rea 'companion' (general).
Leader/clan-chief (especially Edom-genealogies); distinguished from alluf I (intimate); concordantly 'chieftain'.

Num-they-departed-from-Dophkah-and-encamped-in-Alush and Num-they-departed-from-Alush-and-encamped-in-Rephidim (Num 33:13,14). Hyphenated to distinguish the Alush-stop-wilderness-Sin-aspect from other stops; wilderness-journey-Sinai-Rephidim-route-Num-33-itinerary.
1Chr-Adai-Eliel-Joha-and-Elzabad and 1Chr-and-Elzabad-his-brother-men-of-valour-Elihu-and-Semachiah (1Chr 12:12; 26:7). Hyphenated.

All-people-become-corrupt and Ps-all-of-humanity-spoiled and Job-loathsome-become (Job 15:16; Ps 14:3; 53:4). Hyphenated to distinguish the become-corrupt-spoil-aspect from H7843 shachath 'corrupt-make' (already assigned).

David's mighty man who killed a giant and son of Dodo (2Sam 21:19; 23:24; 1Chr 11:26; 20:5). English convention: Elhanan. 'God-is-gracious'; family with H2603a chanan 'be-gracious' (already assigned).
Proper noun ('my-God-is-Father'); among others eldest brother of David; concordantly transliterated.

Theophoric-name 'my-Mighty-One is El' - several persons: Manasseh-half head of-clans in-Bashan (1Chr 5:24), Kohath-Levite priest (1Chr 6:34), Benjamite (1Chr 8:20,22), David's-mighty-men (1Chr 11:46-47 twice), Gadite-David-supporter (1Chr 12:11).
1Chr-Bukkiah-Mattaniah-Uzziel-Shebuel-and-Jerimoth-Hananiah-Hanani-Eliathah-Giddalti-and-Romamti-Ezer-Joshbekashah-Mallothi-Hothir-Mahazioth and 1Chr-the-twentieth-Eliathah (1Chr 25:4,27).
Proper noun, Benjamin-leader at land-allotment; Num 34:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elidad.
David's son and Aramean-prince and Judah-commander (2Sam 5:16; 1Kgs 11:23; 1Chr 3:8; 2Chr 17:17). English convention: Eliada. 'God-knows'; family with H3045 yada 'know'.
Fat-tail-portion of consecrated ram for altar (Ex 29:22; Lev 3:9; 7:3; 8:25; 9:19). Not hyphenated; fat-tail-sheep-tail as technical offering-portion.
Proper noun ('my El is YHWH'); prophet; concordantly transliterated.

Fourth Job-speaker, son of Barachel the Buzite (Job 32:2,4,5,6, 34:1, 35:1, 36:1); also Samuel's ancestor Zuph-Ephraimite (1Sam 1:1), Manassite David-supporter (1Chr 12:20), Korahite gatekeeper (1Chr 26:7), David's brother in genealogy (1Chr 27:18).
A Korahite gatekeeper under Obed-Edom in David's time - 1Chronicles 26:3; disambiguated from a returnee with the same root-name Elioenai (H454b).
Various post-exilic descendants-heads (1Chr 3:23,24; 4:36; 7:8; 26:3; Ezra 8:4; 10:22,27; Neh 12:41). 'Toward-YHWH-are-my-eyes'. English convention: Elioenai.
2S-Eliahba-the-Shaalbonite-of-the-sons-of-Jashen-Jonathan and 1Chr-Eliahba-the-Shaalbonite-of-the-sons-of-Hashem-the-Gizonite (2S 23:32; 1Chr 11:33). Hyphenated.
Solomon-scribe 1Kgs 4:3, brother of Ahijah, son of Shisha; theophoric proper noun (El-).
Insignificant idol, vanity; concordantly 'nothingness'.
Husband of Naomi in book of Ruth (Ruth 1:2,3; 2:1,3; 4:3,9). 'My-God-is-king'. English convention: Elimelech.

Aramaic-demonstrative 'these' for kings and images (Ezra 4:21; 5:15; 6:8; Dan 6:6,24; 7:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the these-mentioned-aramaic-aspect from H428 elleh 'these' (already assigned) and H411 el-III 'these-pointing' (already assigned).
Gad- and Levitical tribe-head (Num 1:14; 2:14; 3:24; 7:42,47; 10:20). 'God-has-added'. English convention: Eliasaph.
Proper noun ('my-God-is-help'); Abraham's servant from Damascus, son of Moses, multiple persons; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, Benjamin-son of Shimei; 1Chr 8:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elienai.
Proper noun, father of Bathsheba; 2Sam 11:3; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eliam.
Proper noun ('God-is-gold'); son of Esau and a friend of Job from Teman; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, David's-warrior son of Ur; 1Chr 11:35; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eliphal.
1Chr-and-Eliphelehu-and-Mikneiah-and-Obed-Edom-and-Jeiel-the-gatekeepers and 1Chr-id (1Chr 15:18,21).
Son of David and other Davidites (2Sam 5:16; 23:34; 1Chr 3:6,8; 8:39; 14:7; Ezra 8:13; 10:33). 'My-God-is-deliverance'. English convention: Eliphelet.
Reubenite tribe-head at Sinai-numbering (Num 1:5; 2:10; 7:30,35; 10:18). English convention: Elizur. 'My-God-is-rock'.
Levite and Zebulonite-leader (Ex 6:22; Lev 10:4; Num 3:30; 34:25; 1Chr 15:8; 2Chr 29:13). 'God-has-hidden'. English convention: Elizaphan.
Proper noun, David's-warrior Harodite; 2Sam 23:25; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elika.

Steward of Hezekiah, participant Rabshakeh-negotiations (2Kgs 18:18,26,37, 19:2, Isa 22:20 YHWH-chosen-servant, 36:3,11,22, 37:2); also original name of king Jehoiakim before Pharaoh-Necho renamed him (2Kgs 23:34, 2Chr 36:4); priest-Neh-12.
Proper noun, wife of Aaron; Ex 6:23; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elisheba.
Elishah-son-of-Javan and Tyre-trade-partner (Gen 10:4; 1Chr 1:7; Eze 27:7). English convention: Elishah-people-son. Distinguished from prophet-H477 Elisha (already assigned). 'God-is-salvation'.
2S-his-names-that-were-born-to-him-Shammuah-Shobab-Nathan-Solomon-Ibhar-Elishua and 1Chr-id (2S 5:15; 1Chr 14:5).
Proper noun ('God-restores'); high priest in Nehemiah's time, and several others; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('God-has-heard'); various persons (prince of Ephraim, priests, scribe of Jeremiah); concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun ('El has saved'); prophet, successor of Elijah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, captain in Jehoiada's-revolt against Athaliah; 2Chr 23:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elishaphat.
Aramaic demonstrative pronoun pl: these, those (Dan/Ezra); the hyphenated English marks language and number.

The deep lament of the afflicted - Job 10:15 (and woe to me, for if I am righteous, I shall not lift up my head) and Micah 7:1 (woe to me, for it goes with me as with the gatherings of the summer-fruits).

Niphal/Piel: by-shock-or-command-become-speechless distinguished from charash (be-silent, H2790b) and chashah (keep-quiet, H2814) by the sudden-speechlessness-aspect (Gen 37:7 Joseph's-dream 'we-were-becoming-mute-of-sheaves in-the-midst-of-field').
Psalm-title Ps 16, 56-60 miktam-designation; possibly inscription or golden-saying.
Not-able-to-speak, of person or image (Ex 4:11; Ps 38:14; 39:3,10; Prov 31:8; Isa 35:6; 56:10; Hab 2:18). Hyphenated to preserve the speech-impeded-state.

Hiram-shipments-sandalwood-Ophir and temple-stairs-and-harps-lyres (1Kgs 10:11,12). Hyphenated to distinguish the sandalwood-algum-precious-wood-aspect from H730 erez 'cedar' (already assigned) and H1265 berosh 'cypress-juniper' (already assigned).
Bound sheaf of harvest (Gen 37:7; Ps 126:6). Hyphenated to distinguish the bound-sheaf-aspect from H6016b omer-II 'grain-sheaf' (loose garve).
Gen-sons-Shobal-Alvan-Manahath-Ebal-Shepho and 1Chr-sons-Shobal-Alian-Manahath (Gen 36:23; 1Chr 1:40). Hyphenated; Edomite-autochthonous-Horite-genealogy.
Proper noun, Asher-city; Josh 19:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Allammelech.
Israel not-forsaken-to-widowhood by God; Jer 51:5.
Babel-shall-suddenly-come-to-widowhood; Isa 47:9.
Woman whose husband has died; social category in legal texts; concordantly 'widow'.
State-of-widowhood and mourning-attire (Gen 38:14,19; Isa 54:4; 2Sam 20:3). Hyphenated; family with H490 almanah 'widow'.

Boaz-addresses-unknown-redeemer and David-place-encampment-such-and-such (Ruth 4:1; 1Sam 21:3; 2Kgs 6:8). Hyphenated to distinguish the unnamed-no-name-aspect; forms pair peloni-almoni 'such-and-such'.
Proper noun, father of David's-warriors Jeribai/Joshaviah; 1Chr 11:46; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elnaam.
Grandfather of Jeconiah and emissary in Jehoiakim's time (2Kgs 24:8; Jer 26:22; 36:12,25; Ezra 8:16). 'God-has-given'. English convention: Elnathan.
Gen-Arioch-king-Ellasar and Gen-same-coalition-repetition (Gen 14:1,9). Hyphenated; possibly-Larsa-South-Mesopotamia-small-kingdom.
Proper noun, Ephraim-son killed by men of Gath; 1Chr 7:21; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elead.
Proper noun, Ephraim-tribe-head; 1Chr 7:20; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eladah.
Proper noun, Benjamite David's-warrior Ziklag; 1Chr 12:5; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eluzai.
Proper noun ('El has helped'); priest-son of Aaron; concordantly transliterated.
Moabite city in Reuben's inheritance (Num 32:3,37; Isa 15:4; 16:9; Jer 48:34). English convention: Elealeh. 'God-has-exalted-himself'.
Post-exilic Levite and several persons (1Chr 2:39,40; 8:37; 9:43; Ezra 10:22; Jer 29:3). 'God-has-made'. English convention: Elasah.

Instruction-teaching to Job and wisdom-learning (Job 15:5; 33:33; 35:11; Prov 22:25). Hyphenated to distinguish the teach-instruct-aspect from homonym H5968 alaf 'faint' (already assigned) and H3925 lamad 'teach' (already assigned).
Hiphil-participle; our-flocks thousand-fold in stalls; Ps 144:13.

Homonym of H505 'thousand': tribal sub-unit (Num 1:16; 10:4,36; Josh 22:14,21,30; Judg 6:15; 1Sam 10:19,21; 23:23; Mic 5:1). Hyphenated via '-II' to maintain distinction with H505 semantically and numerically.
Cardinal numeral. 'Thousand' standard.
Aramaic-equivalent for number-thousand (Dan 5:1; 7:10; Ezra 6:17). Hyphenated to mark the Aramaic-parallel; family with H505 elef 'thousand' (Hebrew).
Proper noun, Benjamin-city; Josh 18:28; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eleph.

Elpaal-Benjamite-tribe-head-son-of-Hushim and Elpaal-builder-of-Ono-and-Lod and Elpaal-Beriah-father (1Chr 8:11,12,18). English convention: Elpaal. 'God-works' or 'God-makes' (El-God + pa'al-work already assigned).
Piel; Delilah pressed Samson daily; Judg 16:16.
King-against-whom-no-one-can-rise; Prov 30:31.
Proper noun ('God-has-acquired'); father of Samuel and several Levites; concordantly transliterated.
Patronym-clan inhabitant of Elkosh; Nah 1:1; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Elkoshite.

Josh-Eltolad-Chesil-Hormah and Josh-and-the-inheritance-of-the-sons-of-Simeon-was-in-the-midst-of-the-inheritance-of-the-sons-of-Judah-Beersheba-Sheba-Moladah-Hazar-shual-Balah-Ezem-Eltolad (Josh 15:30; 19:4). Hyphenated.
Josh-Jehud-Bene-berak-Gath-rimmon-Eltekeh-Gibbethon-Baalath and Josh-from-tribe-of-Dan-Eltekeh-Gibbethon-four-cities-priests (Josh 19:44; 21:23). Hyphenated.
Proper noun, Judah-hill-country-city; Josh 15:59; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Eltekon.
Psalms-title-designation (Ps 46:1, 1Chr 15:20); from H5959 alma virgin, possibly high-voice-choir.
Basic kinship-term; parallel av (H1). 'Mother' standard.
Conditional conjunction. 'If' covers hypothetical; assertive function (oath-formula 'if...!') shares the same conditional kernel.
Variant of H518a. Concordantly 'unless'. Audit 2026-04-26: distinguishing from H518a conditional 'if'. Cluster with H3588b in ki-im combination.
Female slave of higher status than shifchah; concordantly 'maidservant'.
Length-unit (forearm). 'Cubit' is the English traditional length-measure-equivalent; 'elbow-measure' would be too verbal.
Second-sense ammah; doorpost-temple-shaken; Isa 6:4.
Aramaic-cubit-measure of temple-dimensions (Ezra 6:3 twice; Dan 3:1 twice). Hyphenated to distinguish the cubit-measure-aspect from H520a ammah 'cubit' (already assigned); Aramaic cognate.
Proper noun, hill where Joab pursued Abner; 2Sam 2:24; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ammah.

Ishmael-tribes and praise-YHWH-all-tribes (Gen 25:16; Num 25:15; Ps 117:1). Hyphenated to distinguish the tribe-nation-people-clan-aspect from homonym H5980 ummah 'beside' (already assigned) and H1471a goy 'people' (already assigned) and H5971a am 'people'.
Aramaic 'people-community/nation' (Dan 3:4,7,29; 5:19; 6:26; 7:14). Concordant via '-aramaic' suffix; family with Hebrew H523 ummah.
Wisdom was master-worker beside God; Prov 8:30.
Proper noun ('faithful'); king of Judah and a governor; concordantly transliterated.
People-multitude Jerusalem-carried-away by Nebuchadnezzar; Jer 52:15.

Proper noun Amon, the Egyptian city-god of No (Thebes) - in Jeremiah 46:25 (I will punish Amon of No) and Nahum 3:8 (are you better than No-amon which lay among the rivers?); sun-god-state-cult of Thebes.

God's-faithfulness or trustworthy-people (Deut 32:20; Prov 13:17; 20:6; Isa 26:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the faithfulness-firmness-aspect from H530 emunah 'faithfulness' (already assigned); family with H539 aman 'be-firm'.
From √aman (be-firm/trustworthy); steadfast faithfulness, reliability; concordantly 'faithfulness'.
Proper noun; father of prophet Isaiah; concordantly transliterated.
Proper noun, father of Solomon's-servants-clan returnees; Ezra 2:57; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Ami.

Brave-firm of heart or horse (2Sam 15:12; 2Chr 13:18; 17:7 (?); Job 9:4,19; Isa 28:2; 40:26; Amos 2:16). Hyphenated to distinguish the firm-resolute-strength from H1368 gibbor 'strong-mighty', H5797 oz 'strength' and H2389 chazaq 'strong'; family with H553 amets.

The treetop or summit-branch as the uppermost point - in Isaiah 17:6 (two or three berries in the top) and Isaiah 17:9 (in that day his strong cities shall be as a forsaken bough and as the topmost branch); related to amar (announce, prominent).
Qal/Pulal: pine away, wither (agriculture, people); the hyphenated English marks weakening.
David: 'heal-me for I-am-weakened'; Ps 6:2.
Proper noun, Judah-city south; Josh 15:26; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Amam.
Root 'mn. Stem-related emet (faithfulness, H571). Hiphil: hold-firm, trust. 'Believe' preserves the trust-dimension; shares with batach (H982) semantically but etymologically distinct.

Aramaic verb for believing or trusting - in Daniel 6:4 (no error or fault was found in him) and Daniel 6:23 (no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God); parallel of Hebrew aman.
Hiphil; people-turn-aside-right or-left; Isa 30:21.
Work-of-art-craftsman bride-thigh-curves; Song 7:1.
From √aman (firm/faithful); affirmation-formula 'it is firm'; concordantly transliterated.
YHWH-does-wonders out-of old-faithful-counsel; Isa 25:1.
Esther kept Mordecai's-command as in upbringing; Esth 2:20.

Gen-indeed-she-is-my-sister-daughter-of-my-father and Josh-in-truth-I-have-sinned (Gen 20:12; Josh 7:20). Hyphenated to distinguish the in-truth-indeed-really-aspect from H543 amen 'so-be-it' (already assigned); family with H544.
Gold-coverings temple-doorposts Hezekiah stripped-off; 2Kgs 18:16.

The solemn written covenant which Nehemiah and the leaders signed to keep the law - Nehemiah 9:38 (we make a sure covenant and write it); 11:23 (a fixed ordinance for the singers); from H539 aman (be-faithful-firm).
Proper noun, mountain-top north of Lebanon; Song 4:8; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Amana.
Proper noun ('faithful'); son of David; concordantly transliterated.

Affirming exclamation; 'so-it-is' (Num 22:37; Josh 7:20; 2Kgs 19:17; Ruth 3:12; Job 9:2; 12:2; 19:4,5; 34:12; 36:4; Ps 58:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the rhetorical-affirming-adverbial from H543 amen (liturgical).
Affirming-reality (Gen 18:13; Num 22:37; 1Kgs 8:27; Ps 58:2). Hyphenated to distinguish the reality-affirming-aspect from H551 amnam 'verily' (already assigned) and H61 aval 'surely'; family.
Qal: be powerful; Piel: make strong; often paired with chazaq; concordantly 'be-strong' hyphenated.

Strong-muscled or bay-spotted (of horses) - in Zechariah 6:3 (in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot strong dappled horses) and Zechariah 6:7 (the strong horses went out and sought to go); from H553 amats (be-strong).
Pure-person grows in courage-resoluteness; Job 17:9.
Judah-princes-shall-say 'my-strength-the-inhabitants'; Zech 12:5.
1Chr-Bani-the-son-of-Shamer-the-son-of-Mahli-the-son-of-Mushi and Neh-Adaiah-the-son-of-Jeroham-the-son-of-Pelaliah-the-son-of-Amzi (1Chr 6:46; Neh 11:12 cf). Hyphenated.
Proper noun ('YHWH-is-mighty'); king of Judah; concordantly transliterated.
Root 'mr. Unambiguous speech-verb; derivatives emer (saying, H561), omer (word, H562), imrah (utterance, H565).
Aramaic; concordantly identical to H559 amar Hebrew.
From √amar (say); utterance/word; distinguished from davar (broader); concordantly 'saying'.

Utterance or poetic-saying (Job 22:28; Ps 19:3,4; 68:12; 77:9; Hab 3:9). Hyphenated to distinguish the spoken-utterance-aspect from H561 imrah 'saying' and H1697 davar 'word'; family with H559 amar 'say'.

Ezra-sacrifice-temple-dedication-hundred-bulls-two-hundred-rams-four-hundred-lambs (Ezra 6:9,17; 7:17). Hyphenated to distinguish the lamb-offering-lamb-aramaic-aspect from Hebrew H3532 keves 'lamb' (already assigned) and H561 emer 'word' (already assigned).
Priestly head of-the-sixteenth-division returned-from-exile (1Chr 9:12 = Neh 11:13, 24:14 David's-establishment-priestly-classes 'sixteenth for Immer, seventeenth for Hezir').
From √amar (say); spoken-word (often poetic, Ps 119); concordantly 'utterance'.
Second-sense imrah; YHWH-fulfilled his-word-decree; Lam 2:17.
Proper noun, Judah-father of Uthai post-exile; 1Chr 9:4; concordantly transliterated. English convention: Imri.
Proper noun (gentilic). English convention Amorite.
Proper noun ('YHWH-has-promised'); priests and Levites in genealogies; concordantly transliterated.
Gen-Amraphel-king-Shinar-Arioch-Ellasar-Chedorlaomer-Tidal-king-Goyim-coalition and Gen-same-kings-mentioned-again (Gen 14:1,9). Hyphenated.

Direct-past nightly time (Gen 19:34; 31:29,42; 2Kgs 9:26; Job 30:3). Hyphenated to distinguish the yesterday-evening-past-aspect from H8543 temol 'yesterday' and H865 etmol 'yesterday-formerly' (already assigned).

Root 'mn (be-firm, H539). Reliability, truth. The hyphenated English preserves both the relational firmness ('faithfulness') and the propositional firmness ('truth') that emet carries; English forces the choice that NL 'trouw' covers in one word. 'Truth' alone is cognitive splinter that loses the relational dimension.
Large leather-sack for grain-transport (sons of Jacob in Egypt); the hyphenated English marks function.

2K-according-to-the-word-of-the-LORD-God-of-Israel-which-He-spoke-by-the-hand-of-His-servant-Jonah-the-son-of-Amittai-the-prophet and Jonah-the-word-of-the-LORD-came-to-Jonah-the-son-of-Amittai (2K 14:25; Jonah 1:1).
Aramaic for fearful-fourth-beast; Dan 7:7.
Interrogative adverb of direction; concordantly 'whither'.
The Aramaic first-person-pronoun 'I' - Ezra 6:12 (I Darius have made the decree), 7:21; Daniel passim; Aramaic parallel to Hebrew ani-anokhi.

Aramaic first-person-singular pronoun 'I' (Dan 2:8,23-24 'I, Daniel, gave thanks', 3:25 'I see four men', 4:4,7,10,34-37 'I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes', 5:16 'I have heard of you', 7:15,28, Ezra 6:12, 7:21 'I, Artaxerxes, decree'); concordantly transliterated.
